claims.quote: The symbolic solver decides `number/floor`, `number/ceiling`, `number/round` (with optional constant places), `number/remainder` by any known non-zero divisor, and `value/integer?` on arbitrary real expressions via exact Skolem integer variables, e.g. `["query", ["not", ["exists", ["?n"], ["and", ["schema/fits?", "?n", "value/integer?"], ["=", ["number/remainder", "?n", 2], 0], ["not", ["value/integer?", ["number/divide", "?n", 2]]]]]]]` proves every even integer halves to an integer (`[{}]`).
The symbolic solver decides `number/remainder` by a known non-zero divisor, `number/floor`, `number/ceiling`, `number/round`, and `value/integer?` on arbitrary numbers.
